goal: Provide clear, network-aware error messages when an address belongs to a different network
Prevents user confusion from generic unsupported-encoding errors when using valid cross-network addresses
reviewability: Conflicts with master, but the rebase is mechanical and the logic is ready to review
agreement: Broad concept approval for clearer address validation error messages (Sjors, rkrux, jonatack, l0rinc)
Tested and inspected address decoding changes across commits (Sjors)
Blocking objection: bundling large refactors and behavior changes across commits impedes review (l0rinc)
Nonblocking objections on potential string_view lifetime issues and redundant reparsing (l0rinc)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because clearer diagnostic messages prevent RPC user confusion when using addresses from another network
The underlying address validation failure is not an operational breakage or critical bug

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because it provides a cleaner internal error-reporting interface across address parsing utilities
Replaces prefix-guessing heuristics with structured error reporting without changing core functionality
